nodes.long_description:
Comece no Moonrise Clubhouse: atravesse um portal para um dos sete percursos de 18 buracos, ou fique para jogar. Quatro percursos são grátis; Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley e Monster Mansion são expansões.

NOVO, MONSTER MANSION: Uma casa mal-assombrada numa noite de tempestade. Uma criatura da lagoa golpeia a sua bola, um ímã a faz flutuar até um buraco no teto, e o gigante da torre acorda na última tacada. Grátis até 8 de novembro: termine uma partida até lá e ele é seu.

NOVO, JOGOS DO CLUBHOUSE: Pingue-pongue contra Ollie, a lontra, com efeito de verdade e quatro níveis. Boliche ao pôr do sol num píer sobre o mar. Atomic Moonshot, um pinball numa corrida até a lua com rampas, modos e multibola.

DINOSAUR VALLEY: Dinossauros simpáticos, um tobogã de lama e um vulcão em erupção.

LANTERN COVE: A hora dourada à beira-mar, com final sob o farol.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: Uma noite brilhante. Túneis de raízes e a subida ao Mother Shroom.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW: Uma aconchegante noite de Halloween. Final dentro do Great Jack.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS: A ensolarada cidade do amanhã. O Starliner decola no 18.

GLOWTOWN: Uma cidade neon do show business. Use os flippers de um pinball no céu.

DESAFIO DIÁRIO: Um novo todo dia. Três tentativas, vale a melhor.

JOGUE JUNTO: Partidas privadas para até quatro com chat de voz; silencie, bloqueie ou denuncie quando quiser.

TACADA REAL: A bola é simulada 360 vezes por segundo. Dez bolas perdidas por percurso. Modo sentado, jogo canhoto, bolas para daltônicos.
nodes.short_description: Minigolfe, boliche, pingue-pongue e pinball em VR grátis com amigos. Quatro percursos de 18 buracos são grátis, de uma enseada na hora dourada a uma ensolarada cidade retrô no céu, além de Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley e Monster Mansion como expansões. Novo: Monster Mansion, grátis até 8 de novembro. Física real, um desafio diário e partidas privadas online para até quatro com chat de voz. O jogo está em inglês.

nodes.long_description:
Moonrise Clubhouse에서 포털을 지나 18홀 코스 7개 중 하나로, 아니면 클럽하우스에서 게임 한 판. 4개 코스는 무료, Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley, Monster Mansion은 확장 콘텐츠입니다.

신규 MONSTER MANSION: 폭풍우 치는 밤의 유령의 집. 석호의 괴물이 공을 쳐 내고, 자석이 공을 천장의 홀까지 띄워 올리며, 마지막 퍼트에 탑의 거인이 깨어납니다. 11월 8일까지 무료: 그때까지 한 라운드를 끝내면 계속 당신의 코스입니다.

신규 클럽하우스 게임: 수달 Ollie와 진짜 스핀이 살아 있는 탁구, 난이도 4단계. 노을 진 바다 위 부두에서 훅과 핀 액션이 살아 있는 볼링. 달을 향한 로켓 레이스 핀볼 Atomic Moonshot, 램프와 모드와 멀티볼까지.

DINOSAUR VALLEY: 다정한 공룡들, 진흙 미끄럼틀, 분화하는 화산.

LANTERN COVE: 바닷가의 노을, 등대 아래에서 마무리.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: 빛나는 밤. 뿌리 터널을 지나 Mother Shroom으로.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW: 아늑한 할로윈 밤. Great Jack 안에서 마무리.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS: 화창한 미래 도시. 18번 홀에서 Starliner가 날아오릅니다.

GLOWTOWN: 네온 쇼비즈 도시. 하늘 위 핀볼의 플리퍼를 움직입니다.

데일리 챌린지: 매일 새 도전. 기회는 세 번, 최고 기록이 남습니다.

함께 플레이: 코드로 들어오는 비공개 게임. 최대 4명, 음성 채팅. 음소거, 차단, 신고는 언제든지.

진짜 퍼팅: 공은 초당 360번 시뮬레이션됩니다. 코스마다 로스트 볼 10개. 앉아서 플레이, 왼손 플레이, 색각 친화적인 공.
nodes.short_description: 친구와 함께하는 무료 VR 미니골프, 볼링, 탁구, 핀볼. 18홀 코스 4개 무료: 노을 진 바닷가 만부터 하늘 위의 화창한 레트로 도시까지. 여기에 확장 콘텐츠로 Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley, Monster Mansion까지. 신규: Monster Mansion, 11월 8일까지 무료. 실감 나는 물리, 데일리 챌린지, 최대 4명 음성 채팅 비공개 온라인 플레이. 텔레포트나 걷기, 앉아서나 서서, 왼손이든 오른손이든. 게임 언어는 영어입니다.

nodes.long_description:
Moonrise Clubhouse から、ポータルをくぐって18ホールのコース7つへ。クラブハウスでゲームもどうぞ。4コースは無料、Glowtown、Dinosaur Valley、Monster Mansion は追加コンテンツです。

新コース MONSTER MANSION:嵐の夜の幽霊屋敷。ラグーンの怪物がボールをはたき、磁石がボールを天井のカップまで浮かせ、最後のパットで塔の巨人が目を覚まします。11月8日まで無料:それまでに1ラウンド終えれば、ずっとあなたのもの。

新登場 クラブハウスのゲーム:カワウソの Ollie と本格スピンの卓球、レベルは4段階。夕日の桟橋でボウリング、フックもピンアクションも本格派。ピンボール Atomic Moonshot は月を目指すロケットレース、ランプ・モード・マルチボール付き。

DINOSAUR VALLEY:やさしい恐竜たち、泥のスライダー、噴火する火山。

LANTERN COVE:夕暮れの海辺。灯台の下でフィニッシュ。

NEON SHROOM FOREST:光る夜の森。根っこのトンネルを抜けて Mother Shroom へ。

PUMPKIN HOLLOW:ほっこりハロウィンの夜。Great Jack の中でフィニッシュ。

ATOMIC SKYWAYS:晴れた未来都市。18番では Starliner が飛び立ちます。

GLOWTOWN:ネオンのショービズ都市。空中ピンボールのフリッパーを操ります。

デイリーチャレンジ:毎日新しいお題。挑戦は3回、ベストが記録に。

いっしょに遊ぶ:コードで入れるプライベートゲーム。最大4人、ボイスチャット付き。ミュート・ブロック・通報もいつでも。

本格パット:ボールは毎秒360回シミュレート。各コースにロストボール10個。着席モード、左利きプレイ、色覚に配慮したボール。
nodes.short_description: 友だちと遊べる無料のVRミニゴルフ、ボウリング、卓球、ピンボール。18ホールのコース4つが無料:夕暮れの海辺の入り江から、空に浮かぶ晴れたレトロ未来都市まで。さらに追加コンテンツとして「Glowtown」「Dinosaur Valley」「Monster Mansion」。新登場:Monster Mansion、11月8日まで無料。本格的な物理演算、デイリーチャレンジ、最大4人のボイスチャット付きプライベートオンライン対戦。テレポートでも歩きでも、座っても立っても、左利きでも右利きでも遊べます。ゲーム内の言語は英語です。

nodes.long_description:
Empieza en el Moonrise Clubhouse: cruza un portal a uno de los siete recorridos de 18 hoyos, o quédate a jugar. Cuatro recorridos son gratis; Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley y Monster Mansion son expansiones.

NUEVO, MONSTER MANSION: Una casa encantada en una noche de tormenta. Una criatura de la laguna golpea tu bola, un imán la hace flotar hasta un hoyo en el techo y el gigante de la torre despierta con el último golpe. Gratis hasta el 8 de noviembre: termina una partida antes y es tuyo.

NUEVO, JUEGOS DEL CLUBHOUSE: Ping-pong contra Ollie la nutria, con efecto real y cuatro niveles. Bolos al atardecer en un muelle sobre el mar. Atomic Moonshot, un pinball de carrera a la luna con rampas, modos y multibola.

DINOSAUR VALLEY: Dinosaurios amistosos, un tobogán de barro y un volcán en erupción.

LANTERN COVE: La hora dorada junto al mar, final bajo el faro.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: Una noche luminosa. Túneles de raíces y la subida a la Mother Shroom.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW: Una acogedora noche de Halloween. Final dentro del Great Jack.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS: La soleada ciudad del mañana. El Starliner despega en el 18.

GLOWTOWN: Una ciudad de neón y espectáculos. Maneja las aletas de un pinball en el cielo.

DESAFÍO DIARIO: Uno nuevo cada día. Tres intentos, cuenta el mejor.

JUGAR JUNTOS: Partidas privadas de hasta cuatro con chat de voz; silencia, bloquea o denuncia cuando quieras.

GOLPE REAL: La bola se simula 360 veces por segundo. Modo sentado, juego zurdo, bolas aptas para daltónicos.

Cuatro recorridos de 18 hoyos son gratis, de una cala en la hora dorada a una soleada ciudad retro en el cielo, más Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley y Monster Mansion como expansiones. nodes.long_description:
Start at the Moonrise Clubhouse: step through a portal to one of seven 18-hole courses, or stay for a game. Four courses are free to play; Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley and Monster Mansion are add-ons.

NEW, MONSTER MANSION: A haunted house on a stormy night. A lagoon creature swats at your ball, a magnet floats it up to a cup on the ceiling, and the giant in the tower wakes when you sink the last putt. Free to play through November 8: finish a round by then and it's yours to keep.

NEW, CLUBHOUSE GAMES: Ping pong against Ollie the otter, with real spin and four levels. Bowling at sunset on a pier over the sea. Atomic Moonshot pinball, a rocket race to the moon with ramps, modes and multiball.

DINOSAUR VALLEY: Friendly dinosaurs, a mud luge and an erupting volcano.

LANTERN COVE: Golden hour by the sea, finishing under the lighthouse.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: A glowing night. Roll through root tunnels and up the Mother Shroom.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW: A cozy Halloween night. Finish inside the Great Jack.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS: The sunny city of tomorrow. Watch the Starliner lift off on 18.

GLOWTOWN: A neon showbiz city. Work the flippers on a sky-arcade pinball table.

DAILY CHALLENGE: A new one every day. Three tries, your best counts.

PLAY TOGETHER: Private games for up to four with voice chat; mute, block or report anyone.

REAL PUTTING: The ball is simulated 360 times a second. Find ten lost balls on every course. Seated mode, left-handed play, colour-blind friendly balls.
nodes.short_description: Free VR mini golf, bowling, ping pong and pinball with friends. Four 18-hole courses are free to play, from a golden-hour seaside cove to a sunny retro city in the sky, plus Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley and Monster Mansion as add-ons. New: Monster Mansion, free to play through November 8. Real physics, a daily challenge and private online games for up to four with voice chat. Teleport or walk, sit or stand, left- or right-handed.

nodes.long_description:
Du Moonrise Clubhouse, un portail mène à l'un des sept parcours de 18 trous, ou restez pour une partie. Quatre parcours sont gratuits ; Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley et Monster Mansion sont des extensions.

NOUVEAU, MONSTER MANSION : Une maison hantée par une nuit d'orage. Une créature du lagon frappe votre balle, un aimant la fait flotter jusqu'à un trou au plafond, et le géant de la tour se réveille au dernier putt. Gratuit jusqu'au 8 novembre : finissez une partie d'ici là, il est à vous.

NOUVEAU, LES JEUX DU CLUBHOUSE : Ping-pong contre Ollie la loutre, avec un vrai effet et quatre niveaux. Bowling au coucher du soleil sur un ponton au-dessus de la mer. Atomic Moonshot, un flipper en course vers la lune avec rampes, modes et multiball.

DINOSAUR VALLEY : Des dinosaures sympathiques, une glissade de boue et un volcan en éruption.

LANTERN COVE : L'heure dorée au bord de la mer, fin sous le phare.

NEON SHROOM FOREST : Une nuit lumineuse, jusqu'au Mother Shroom.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW : Une douce nuit d'Halloween. Fin dans le Great Jack.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS : La ville ensoleillée de demain. Le Starliner décolle au 18.

GLOWTOWN : Une ville néon, et un flipper dans le ciel.

DÉFI QUOTIDIEN : Un nouveau chaque jour. Trois essais, le meilleur compte.

JOUER ENSEMBLE : Parties privées jusqu'à quatre avec chat vocal ; coupez le son, bloquez ou signalez à tout moment.

UN VRAI PUTTING : La balle est simulée 360 fois par seconde. Mode assis, jeu gaucher, balles adaptées au daltonisme.
nodes.short_description: Du mini-golf, du bowling, du ping-pong et du flipper en VR gratuits entre amis. Quatre parcours de 18 trous sont gratuits, d'une crique au coucher du soleil à une ville rétro ensoleillée dans le ciel, plus Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley et Monster Mansion en extensions. Nouveau : Monster Mansion, gratuit jusqu'au 8 novembre. Une vraie physique, un défi quotidien et des parties privées en ligne jusqu'à quatre avec chat vocal. Le jeu est en anglais.

nodes.long_description:
Vom Moonrise Clubhouse durch ein Portal auf einen von sieben Kursen mit je 18 Löchern, oder bleib für ein Spiel. Vier Kurse sind kostenlos; Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley und Monster Mansion sind Erweiterungen.

NEU, MONSTER MANSION: Ein Spukhaus in stürmischer Nacht. Ein Lagunenmonster schlägt nach deinem Ball, ein Magnet lässt ihn zu einem Loch an der Decke schweben, und der Riese im Turm erwacht beim letzten Putt. Bis 8. November kostenlos: Wer bis dahin eine Runde beendet, behält den Kurs.

NEU, CLUBHAUS-SPIELE: Tischtennis gegen Ollie den Otter, mit echtem Spin und vier Stufen. Bowling bei Sonnenuntergang auf einem Steg über dem Meer. Atomic Moonshot, ein Flipper-Wettrennen zum Mond mit Rampen, Modi und Multiball.

DINOSAUR VALLEY: Freundliche Dinosaurier, eine Schlammbahn und ein ausbrechender Vulkan.

LANTERN COVE: Goldenes Abendlicht am Meer, Finale unter dem Leuchtturm.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: Eine leuchtende Nacht, hinauf auf den Mother Shroom.

PUMPKIN HOLLOW: Eine gemütliche Halloween-Nacht. Finale im Great Jack.

ATOMIC SKYWAYS: Die sonnige Stadt von morgen. Auf Loch 18 hebt der Starliner ab.

GLOWTOWN: Eine Neon-Showstadt. Flipper auf einem Himmels-Flipperautomaten.

TAGES-CHALLENGE: Jeden Tag eine neue. Drei Versuche, der beste zählt.

ZUSAMMEN SPIELEN: Private Runden für bis zu vier mit Sprachchat; stummschalten, blockieren oder melden jederzeit.

ECHTES PUTTEN: Der Ball wird 360-mal pro Sekunde simuliert. Sitzmodus, Linkshänder-Modus, farbenblindfreundliche Bälle.
nodes.short_description: Kostenloses VR-Minigolf, Bowling, Tischtennis und Flipper mit Freunden. Vier Kurse mit je 18 Löchern sind kostenlos, von einer Bucht im goldenen Abendlicht bis zu einer sonnigen Retro-Stadt am Himmel, dazu Glowtown, Dinosaur Valley und Monster Mansion als Erweiterungen. Neu: Monster Mansion, bis 8. November kostenlos. Echte Physik, eine Tages-Challenge und private Online-Runden für bis zu vier Spieler mit Sprachchat. Das Spiel ist auf Englisch.

nodes.long_description:
Start at the Moonrise Clubhouse, a lantern-lit terrace over a twilight sea. A two-minute tutorial teaches the basics, then step through a portal onto one of two hand-crafted 18-hole courses.

LANTERN COVE: Golden hour by the sea. Bank off a giant conch, putt along stilt-village boardwalks and through a glowing sea-glass grotto, send your ball down pipes and past a shipwreck, and finish under the lighthouse at the Lantern Heart.

NEON SHROOM FOREST: Night in a hushed, bioluminescent forest under a huge moon. Roll through root tunnels and down a log flume, past chiming crystal caps and colossal glowing mushrooms, and climb the towering Mother Shroom for the finale.

EXPLORE: Ten lost balls hide on each course, up the lighthouse stair, behind the falls and deep in the woods.

REAL PUTTING: The ball is simulated 360 times a second, so soft taps stay precise and firm putts carry. Fit the blade putter to your grip, swing, and read every slope and bank. Your score lives on a watch on your wrist.

PLAY TOGETHER: Host a private game and share a short join code. Up to four players play each hole together with voice chat. Mute, block or report anyone at any time.

MOVE YOUR WAY: Teleport or walk, snap or smooth turn with a comfort vignette, or warp straight to your ball. One-controller play, left- or right-handed, colour-blind friendly ball styles and unscored practice. Every sound and every piece of art was made for this game.
nodes.short_description: Two hand-crafted 18-hole courses, a golden-hour seaside cove and a moonlit forest of glowing mushrooms, reached through portals in a cozy seaside clubhouse. Putt with real physics and a blade putter fitted to your hand, learn in a quick tutorial, keep score on your wrist watch, hunt for lost balls, and play with up to three friends online with voice chat. Teleport or walk, even with one controller. Free, with no in-app purchases.
